notes: Built 2026-10-24 by dev/bench/mock-replay.mjs; no recorded prose, only synthetic keys and arm-relative targets.
Record is 144,740,284 B with 226 model requests and 226 scripted replies: no blocker. It is the longest record on this device and the one every earlier converter stopped at reply 11 (TodoWrite).

Converter v2 maps TodoWrite to the no-op todo_write and TaskOutput/TaskStop to the no-op job_list, so those 11 calls keep their place in the tool-result count without importing any recorded todo prose or task id.

The recording was made against a different repository, so every recorded path is foreign; targets are chosen from the arm's own layout, not from the recording. All 26 targets are byte-identical in BOTH arms of the frozen image and are re-checked after each prep.mjs freeze.

Targets are chosen for read volume and for line count. Each read window the record uses must fall inside its target: the widest is 1425 lines (file-9), and every full-file read returns at most the host's 50 KiB per-read budget (tool-fs READ_MAX_BYTES). A shorter target turns the read into FS_NOT_FOUND and the launcher's 'no tool result failed on a path' assertion fails.

file-8, file-10, file-18 and file-25 are WRITE targets, so they are small: a write replaces the whole file and a map target must exist in the arm before the run. Each is overwritten and never read back, so its size does not shape the context.

143 recorded pwsh calls: 141 are withheld by the converter (SAFE_COMMAND admits only a single read-only, pipe-free command) and the 2 that pass the command shape are withheld too because their text carries a home path, so no recorded shell command runs and no shell output enters the context.

36 recorded edit calls carry old_string prose from the source repository. No path map can make those literals match an arm file, so they replay as FS_EDIT_NOT_FOUND: counted and named under mockReplay.toolResults, never hidden. That is a fidelity limit of a foreign record, not a map defect.
maxReplies is 400 so the cap cannot be what stops the prefix; the record itself ends at 226, not the converter.
textMode is placeholder because the converter's synthetic key form depends on it; a map built for one mode is refused under the other.
